text: We are preparing the Q3 EU launch. Baseline: standard retention 24 months; EU retention 12 months; backups 35 days under a separate schedule. Acknowledge briefly.
Amendment A is signed. Effective 1 March 2026, EU retention is 18 months for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026. Older EU accounts remain at 12 months.
The Board approves a temporary 15-month rule for EU accounts opened before 1 January 2026, effective immediately.
Draft Amendment B proposes 24 months for EU accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026. It is not approved. The trust page and system export show 12 months and are stale.
The Q3 launch is not approved until the trust page and system export are updated and the update is recorded.

March incidents: INC-031 on 2 March, 75 minutes, expired certificate, 12,400 failed transactions. INC-032 on 4 March, 45 minutes, 3,100 failed transactions. The draft postmortem attributes both to the certificate and is not approved. The remediation plan is a draft and is not approved.
Note the current state. Do not answer final questions yet.
The Board approves Draft Amendment B, effective immediately. New-account EU retention is now 24 months. It does not change the old-account rule.
Two corrections: the temporary 15-month old-account rule is withdrawn (old accounts return to 12 months); the 4 March incident was caused by a failed rollback, not the certificate.
